correctness.rationale: For every d,t, the centered \(q^d\) Fourier family is orthonormal by exact quadrature and has fixed mean derivative energy. The periodic/antiperiodic min-max bound and its strict equality gap force each character to be a finite low-frequency trigonometric polynomial of modulus one, hence a single monomial. Adjacent-character ratios force affine coordinates. The distinct consecutive dot products with its winding vector give an exact base-q tiling, whose interval induction forces signed permutations of powers \(q^j\); modular reduction proves the converse. Exact code checks supplementary finite cases but cannot prove the infinite statement.
